title: Todoom card
description: One card: boards/<boardId>/cards/<id>.json. Missing fields get defaults; a field of the wrong type makes Todoom skip the file and list it under « fichiers ignorés ». Keep fields you don't know about untouched when rewriting a card.

number.description: Short number on its board: 42 in SOL-42 (the prefix is the board's key). New cards take one more than the highest of the board, archived cards included. Todoom numbers cards that have none, and renumbers the newer of two cards sharing a number.

boardId.description: Informative: the board is the folder the file is in.

columnId.description: Id of a column of board.json; an unknown id shows the card in the first column.

order.description: Position in the column, lowest first. Any number; a card placed between two others gets the midpoint.

priority.description: Id of one of the board's priority levels (board.json priorities, or p1/p2/p3 when the board has none); null for no priority. An unknown id shows as no priority.

links.description: Links to other cards, on any board. Each link is also stored, reversed, on the other card: dependsOn <-> blocks, duplicateOf <-> duplicatedBy, relatesTo <-> relatesTo. Write both sides, or use the todoom command (todoom link).

branch.description: Git branch of the work on this card.

url.description: Web address (https://) of the merge request or pull request.

color.description: Color of the band at the top of the card (#rrggbb), or null for none.

repeat.description: A routine: once the card is in a « done » column, the app makes the next one (id <this id>r<YYYYMMDD>) in the first column, due one period later, and moves the repetition to it.

claimedBy.description: Who is working on the card, also a lock: agents and conversations don't take a card someone else holds. null when nobody is.

at.description: ISO date when it was taken.

archivedAt.description: ISO date when archived; null while on the board.

updatedAt.description: ISO date. Set it on every write: between Drive conflict copies the latest one wins.
